about: FinUI presets: every choice FinUI create offers (create/index.html, and bin/finui.mjs init --preset), in the order a preset code spells them (one base-36 digit per axis). The first option of an axis is tokens.css as it stands and sets nothing. Options are only ever appended, never reordered, so a code once handed out keeps its meaning. Colours are #rrggbb or var(--token); the ramps are Tailwind CSS's (MIT), but Sage's, Blush's and Mist's, which are worked out in OKLCH. Every chart palette keeps neighbouring series at least ΔE 15 apart (OKLab) by day and by night. Styles are whole looks: a name, a line and the options they pick by key, every other axis at its default. Fonts are Fontsource's variable builds (5.3.0) of families under the SIL Open Font License, Latin and Latin Extended, each with its licence in fonts/; Inter and JetBrains Mono are base.css' own.

tokens.--card-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 16%, transparent), 0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 12%, transparent)
0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 14%, transparent), 0 14px 36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 24%, transparent)
0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent), 0 10px 30px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent)

styles.label: Washi
styles.blurb: finstats as it ships: paper and a vermilion seal by day, Obsidian by night.

styles.label: Studio
styles.blurb: Neutral and exact: ink buttons, Geist, small corners, nothing that shouts.

styles.label: Noir
styles.blurb: Black, white and square: capitals for headings, strong lines, no curves.

styles.label: Matinee
styles.blurb: Warm and generous: a serif for headings, soft buttons, cards that lift.

styles.label: Console
styles.blurb: A night shift at the terminal: tight rows, a grid, cyan on deep blue.

styles.label: Pastille
styles.blurb: Round and soft: pill corners, pastel charts, filled fields, a gentle spring.

styles.label: Ledger
styles.blurb: Numbers first: high contrast, heavy headings, compact tables with lines.

styles.label: Gazette
styles.blurb: Set like a newspaper: Playfair headings over Source Serif, ruled and plain.

styles.label: Arcade
styles.blurb: Loud on purpose: block shadows, heavy icons, dots behind, a bouncy step.

styles.label: Canopy
styles.blurb: Green and quiet: moss and lilac, Lexend, rounded cards that float.

styles.label: Harbour
styles.blurb: Cool and clear: mist paper, lagoon and rose, Manrope, a soft focus ring.
